title: asset.updated payload
description: Emitted by MAM when asset metadata changes. Consumed by WebSocket, Search, Logging, and Scheduling (which keeps each asset's approval expiry to validate a schedule against, EP-31).

changedFields.description: Names of the fields that changed.

expiresAt.description: Present exactly when `changedFields` names `expiresAt`: the new value, or null when the expiry was cleared. The one lifecycle value a metadata edit changes, carried so a consumer keeping approvals (Scheduling) never has to read it back from MAM.
